HTTPBearer.description: Use a valid token from the configured identity provider. Swagger UI adds the Bearer prefix. Authentication identifies the caller; each operation checks its own role and resource permissions.

info.description:
Implemented FE APIs cover Parent profiles, a proposed Parent StoryRun slice, organization/class management, consent, and Teacher lesson preparation.

Authentication and role/resource access are checked per operation.

Parent activity catalog, Teacher occurrence, Sketch Deck, sample video, jobs/playback, quota/payment, and notifications are unavailable.

Proposed Parent confirmations and draft SRS status remain subject to approval.
